```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(dbplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(purrr)

# Establish a connection with the database
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(),
                       dbdir = "airbnb_database.duckdb")

DBI::dbListTables(conn)
```


```{r}
# Assign my query to a variable
query <- readLines("project-query.sql") |> paste(collapse = "\n")

# Apply query to database and extract results
best_sf <- dbGetQuery(conn, query)

# Save query results as a csv
write.csv(best_sf, "data/clean/best_sf.csv")
```

```{r}
# Make a theme for our charts
theme_sf <- theme_minimal(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#0f1117", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#0f1117", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#1e2130"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(color = "#c8ccd8"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#8b8fa8", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#e8eaf0", size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#8b8fa8", size = 9,  margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#555970", size = 7,  margin = margin(t = 10)),
    plot.margin = margin(16, 20, 12, 16)
  )
```

```{r}
# Plot 1 - Superhost % by neighbourhood lollipop chart
p1 <- best_sf %>%
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, superhost_pct)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = superhost_pct, y = neighbourhood)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = superhost_pct, yend = neighbourhood),
               color = "#1e2130", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(size = total_listings), color = "#f5a623") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7), name = "Total listings") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), limits = c(0, 105)) +
  labs(
    title = "Superhost Concentration by Neighbourhood",
    subtitle = "Dot size = total listings",
    x  = "% of listings with superhost status",
    y  = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Airbnb San Francisco"
  ) +
  theme_sf +
  theme(legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#0f1117", color = NA),
        legend.text        = element_text(color = "#8b8fa8", size = 7),
        legend.title       = element_text(color = "#8b8fa8", size = 7))
 
ggsave("images/plot1.png", p1,
       width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 180, bg = "#0f1117")
```

```{r}
# Plot 2 - superhost vs non-superhost listings Stacked bar
p2 <- best_sf %>%
  mutate(
    non_superhost = total_listings - superhost_listings,
    neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, superhost_pct)
  ) %>%
  select(neighbourhood, superhost_listings, non_superhost) %>%
  pivot_longer(-neighbourhood,
               names_to = "type",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type,
                       superhost_listings = "Superhost",
                       non_superhost = "Standard")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = count, y = neighbourhood, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Superhost = "#f5a623", Standard = "#2a3a5e"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))) +
  labs(
    title  = "Listing Volume by Neighbourhood & Host Type",
    subtitle = "Ordered by superhost concentration (highest at top)",
    x = "Number of listings",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Airbnb San Francisco"
  ) +
  theme_sf +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#0f1117", color = NA),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "#8b8fa8", size = 8))
 
ggsave("images/plot2.png", p2,
       width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 180, bg = "#0f1117")
```


```{r}
# Disconnect from the database
dbDisconnect(conn)
```
